def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # Locate the solid separator row or column (its color occurs only on that line).
    col_sep=next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and counts[grid[0][c]]==h),None)
    if col_sep is not None:
        a=[row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
        b=[row[col_sep+1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        row_sep=next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and counts[grid[r][0]]==w)
        a=grid[:row_sep]
        b=grid[row_sep+1:]
    bg=Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if a[r][c]==b[r][c] else bg for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
